seo.title: Books
seo.description: Books by Dr. Len Tau: Raving Patients Supercharged, 100+ Tips to Generating 100 5-Star Reviews in 100 Days, and the original Raving Patients.

items.title: Raving Patients Supercharged
items.subtitle: Be Seen. Be Trusted. Be Chosen.
paragraphs: Patients now pick a dentist from reviews, listings, and AI answers before they ever call. This second edition rebuilds my first book for how patients search today.
Inside is the system I used to build a 4.9-star, 2,000+ review practice. QR codes throughout take you to free tools, like my Google Review Calculator. Foreword by Anissa Broussard.
Launched at Supercharge 2026 in Fort Lauderdale.

items.title: 100+ Tips to Generating 100 5-Star Reviews in 100 Days
items.subtitle: Short, practical ideas your team can use tomorrow.
paragraphs: More than 100 tips for asking for, earning, and answering reviews. Hand it to your front desk and your team leaders.

items.title: Raving Patients (2018)
paragraphs: The book that started it all. Now updated and replaced by Raving Patients Supercharged.
